note: Pins on ff-pin-1 beyond the Bitmark-era series manifest. All byte-verified on add except the Bitmark chain archive and HLS masters, which were pinned recursively from their existing CIDs (integrity guaranteed by the CID itself). 2026-09-29 build: adds the Aorist ng-residual entry (feral-file#3464) and the five Refik Anadol Coral masters recovered from the Aorist archive (byte-verified 2026-08-29). The 2026-08-16 build was never published on-chain and is superseded by this one.

collections.description: Media of a2p (2019-2020), the artist-to-artist experiment Feral File grew out of. 144 works across two generations; archives at a2p.bitmark.com. Synced from the original storage and byte-verified 2026-08-03.

The retired Bitmark blockchain (2014-2025), preserved per github.com/bitmark-inc/bitmarkd/wiki/bitmark-archive: chain data on IPFS, Merkle root on Ethereum, timestamp on Bitcoin. Re-pinned on Feral File's archival node 2026-08-03.

HLS master playlists for 184 video works (FeralVerse, On Screen Presence) whose stream files were never placed on IPFS — the masters are preserved here; full video repackaging as directory CIDs is open remediation.

Rescue archive of Aorist, a digital-art initiative that ceased operating; Feral File migrated its collections in 2024 and stewards the works. Complete contents of the two surviving storage buckets — originals, renditions, video, and the two IPFS blockstores from the 2024 migration — restored from cold storage, synced, and byte-verified 2026-08-15, plus the three ng objects outside that sync (two root files and one image uploaded 2026-09-09), banked 2026-09-29 before the buckets were deleted. One CID per source prefix.

Refik Anadol, Machine Hallucinations — Coral — Generative AI Data Painting A–E: the five full-resolution masters (3840×6827) recovered from the Aorist archive. The on-chain tokens reference 640×1138 renditions; these are the originals Feral File stewards and serves for the Refik Anadol Studio channel. Byte-verified on the archival node 2026-08-29 (sha256 in /mnt/ff-pin-data/job/coral_manifest.csv). One CID per file.
